title: Melodia Task Packet
description: One packet is one kanban card. 'Tools/model_router.py route' consumes it. A packet is the ONLY thing a worker may be dispatched from: if a field the router needs is missing, the router must return classical-fallback and the card goes to the owner. Never auto-dispatched, never auto-closed.

id.description: Stable card id. Also the artifact subdirectory name under Saved/Audit/<id>/.

goal.description: What the worker is being asked to do, in one or two sentences. Matched against escalation_triggers[].goal_keywords, so it must name the real action ('widen the schema', not 'small cleanup').

done_when.description: Acceptance criteria. HARD RULE: every entry must name a file or artifact a verifier can open. 'It works' is not a done_when. If the router cannot find any openable artifact for the packet, it returns classical-fallback.

inputs.description: Repo-relative paths the worker may read. Matched against escalation_triggers[].path_globs.

mutation_paths.description: Repo-relative paths the worker intends to write. An EMPTY array with mutation_scope != none is a packet defect and forces classical-fallback. Matched against escalation_triggers[].path_globs before the tier is chosen.

surfaces.description: Surfaces this packet is allowed to touch. 'editor_write' REQUIRES the editor lease (Tools/agent_lease.py) and is refused when mutation_scope is not 'editor'.

mutation_scope.description: none = read-only. files = write repo files. editor = write Unreal assets. git = a git/p4 operation. 'git' is ALWAYS T0_ARCHITECT + owner approval; the router will not auto-dispatch it.

task_class.description: Optional. Must be a key of specs/orchestration/model_tiers.v1.json routing_matrix (python Tools/model_router.py tasks lists them). When present it fixes the BASE tier and the router only ever escalates upward. When absent the router returns classical-fallback - it does not guess.

artifacts_expected.description: Repo-relative artifact paths the worker must produce. Drives verify_kind inference.

verify_kind.description: Optional. How a verifier will accept this packet. Inferred from artifacts_expected when absent. 'none' is only legal when mutation_scope == 'none'.

verifier_class.description: Optional. Forced to a non-producer tier when absent: the router escalates any packet that mutates to at least its tier's verifier requirement. 'no_self_certification' is a registry rule, not a suggestion.

budget_usd.description: Hard spend cap for this packet. Clamped to the tier's budget_usd_max by the router. A T4_LOCAL packet must carry 0.

lease_ttl_s.description: Editor lease TTL when surfaces contains editor_write. Default 900.

notes.description: Human context. NEVER read by the router for tier selection beyond goal_keywords already in 'goal' - prose here cannot lower a tier.

allOf.$comment: A packet that claims to mutate but names no path cannot be checked against escalation_triggers[].path_globs, so it cannot be routed safely. Fail here rather than three layers down.
done_when must name something a verifier can OPEN. 'it looks right' is the canonical bad entry and is rejected by the path-shaped pattern below.
